note.after_visit_summary: We talked about your alcohol use and your mood. Your screening test for alcohol use was 8 out of 12, which is in the risky range. Your mood scores show your depression is currently in remission, and your mood is good. Your blood pressure today was 138 over 88, which is a bit high. We are starting with tests of your liver. If those are normal, we will start a medicine called naltrexone 50 mg by mouth once a day. This helps reduce cravings. Your main goal now is no more than one drink a day and at least three days a week with no alcohol. We have referred you to the Riverbend Recovery Center outpatient program, which has evening groups twice a week. Keep taking bupropion 150 mg every morning. Please call us right away if you get shaky, sweaty, or anxious when you cut back on drinking. If your mood drops or you have thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988. We will check your blood pressure again next visit. Please come back in 4 weeks on October 30th.
